infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ScreamFinder needs access to your photo library to set a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ScreamFinder does not use the camera. This description is required because a bundled SDK references the camera API.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: ScreamFinder does not access your contacts. This description is required because a bundled SDK references the contacts API.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: ScreamFinder does not access your calendar. This description is required because a bundled SDK references the calendar API.
